# William Stonehaven — Founder & Senior Managing Partner

- **Relationship:** Kate's boss and the firm's founder (est. 2009). **Chairs the IC** — no deal
  closes without his sign-off.
- **Cadence:** weekly Monday partner meeting; ad-hoc on live deals.
- **Owns:** overall firm strategy, final IC authority, and the anchor LP relationships.
- **Distinguishing fact:** built SCP from a single fund; still personally underwrites the
  downside case on every platform deal and is skeptical of paying above **8x EBITDA**.

## How to work with him
- Wants the bear case first: what breaks the thesis, and the walk-away price.
- Values discipline over deployment pace — will happily pass on a hot deal.

## Sensitivities
- Burned once by an aggressive QoE that later unwound; extra cautious on add-back-heavy deals —
  relevant to the [Halberd](../projects/halberd.md) re-trade decision.
